rationale: The continuation thesis is intact and strengthening one minute into the trade: price is printing at the high of day (99.6% of range) well above session VWAP, relative volume has expanded to 17x, and the spread has halved to 23bp with zero adverse excursion. No reversal or exhaustion signal and no new headline has emerged, and the short side remains even weaker than at entry since strength is accelerating into new highs, so closing or flipping would abandon a working, risk-defined momentum position. The $8.00 invalidation and trail from the original plan remain appropriate given the risk-off tape (SPY -0.72%, VIXY +3.35%) caps conviction below a strong edge.
